origin.description: Runs the base clustering on resampled rows, keeps all the centers, then cuts a hierarchical clustering of those centers into groups.
origin.usage: bclust(x, centers = 2, iter.base = 10, minsize = 0, dist.method = "euclidean", hclust.method = "average", base.method = "kmeans", base.centers = 20, verbose = TRUE, final.kmeans = FALSE, docmdscale = FALSE, resample = TRUE, weights = NULL, maxcluster = base.centers, ...)

arguments.name: hclust.method
arguments.text: Linkage method for the hierarchical step.

arguments.name: resample
arguments.text: Resample the rows before each base clustering.

origin.details: The example seeds the RNG and turns verbose off so the output is repeatable. The check uses resample = FALSE, which still runs kmeans with random starts.
origin.value: A bclust object with cluster, centers, allcenters, members, and hclust.

translation.description: Python port of bclust. The base step calls the kmeans port, the knn1 step calls class.knn1, and the hierarchical step calls cluster.agnes or cluster.diana.
translation.usage: bclust(x, centers=2, iter_base=10, minsize=0, dist_method="euclidean", hclust_method="average", base_method="kmeans", base_centers=20, verbose=True, final_kmeans=False, docmdscale=False, resample=True, weights=None, maxcluster=None)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Data rows, as a NumPy array.

arguments.name: hclust_method
arguments.text: Linkage method. average, complete, single, and diana work.

arguments.name: resample
arguments.text: Resample the rows before each base clustering.

translation.details: hclust.method ward.D, ward.D2, centroid, median, and mcquitty are not accepted because the hierarchical step uses agnes. docmdscale=True raises NotImplementedError. With minsize > 0, the knn1 step does not reproduce R's random tie draw, so the pruned centers can differ from R when centers tie.
translation.value: A dict with cluster, centers, allcenters, members, and hclust.
translation.example: set_seed(1); x = np.array([[1,2],[1.2,1.8],[1.1,2.2],[5,8],[5.5,7.5],[4.8,8.2],[9,1],[8.5,1.5],[8.2,1.2],[5.2,7.8],[3,3],[3.1,2.9],[0.5,6],[7,4],[6.5,3.5]], dtype=float); bc = bclust(x, 3, iter_base=4, base_centers=4, verbose=False); print(" ".join(str(int(v)) for v in bc["cluster"]) + " "); print(" ".join(f"{v:.4f}" for v in np.asarray(bc["centers"], dtype=float).reshape(-1)) + " ")
